_note: Authored for this benchmark. WSI-FiVE publishes only a lung-specific question set, so these ovarian-tumour questions are a local task extension used to avoid silently applying lung questions to UBC-OCEAN. No native WSI-FiVE answer or evaluation bank exists for this cohort.
questions: What histologic architecture and cell morphology are present in the ovarian tumour?
What is the tumour grade or degree of differentiation, if it can be assessed?
Are papillary, glandular, clear-cell, mucinous, or serous patterns present?
Is there stromal invasion, desmoplasia, necrosis, or another aggressive growth pattern?
Are psammoma bodies, endometriosis-associated changes, or other diagnostically useful background findings present?
Which ovarian carcinoma subtype is most consistent with the combined histologic findings?
